questions.q: Selection uses a condition that is either true or false.
An algorithm that repeats steps uses ____.
A ____ table records the values of variables at each step of an algorithm.
The three basic building blocks of algorithms are sequence, selection and ____.
Checking each item in a list in turn until the target is found is called a ____ search.
Write pseudocode that asks the user for a number and outputs 'Pass' if it is 50 or more, otherwise 'Fail'.
questions.answer: INPUT mark (1); IF mark >= 50 THEN OUTPUT "Pass" (1) ELSE OUTPUT "Fail" (1) ENDIF.

questions.q: Explain the difference between selection and iteration.
questions.answer: Selection chooses which steps to carry out depending on a condition (1); iteration repeats steps (1).

questions.q: Describe how a linear search works.
questions.answer: Start at the first item (1); compare each item with the target in turn until it is found or the end of the list is reached (1).
